Summarise a penguin measurement by a grouping variable

Source: R/summarise_penguins.R
summarise_penguins.Rd

Computes the number of penguins and the mean, standard deviation and range of a chosen body measurement within each level of a grouping variable. Used by the Shiny app and the vignette to turn the raw penguins data into a compact summary table.

Usage

summarise_penguins(data, measure = "body_mass_g", group = "species")

Arguments

data

A data frame of penguin records, such as penguins or a filtered subset of it.

measure

Name of the measurement column to summarise, as a string (e.g. "body_mass_g" or "flipper_length_mm").

group

Name of the column to group by, as a string. Defaults to "species".

Value

A data frame with one row per group and the columns: the grouping variable, n, mean, sd, min and max.

Examples

summarise_penguins(penguins, "body_mass_g")
#> # A tibble: 3 × 6
#>   species       n  mean    sd   min   max
#>   <fct>     <int> <dbl> <dbl> <int> <int>
#> 1 Adelie      146 3706.  459.  2850  4775
#> 2 Chinstrap    68 3733.  384.  2700  4800
#> 3 Gentoo      119 5092.  501.  3950  6300
summarise_penguins(penguins, "flipper_length_mm", group = "island")
#> # A tibble: 3 × 6
#>   island        n  mean    sd   min   max
#>   <fct>     <int> <dbl> <dbl> <int> <int>
#> 1 Biscoe      163  210. 14.3    172   231
#> 2 Dream       123  193.  7.43   178   212
#> 3 Torgersen    47  192.  6.22   176   210
